content:
Caching context:
- Server-side memory cache is registered in AIChatApp.API/Program.cs.
- AssistantContentService caches prompt templates, quick answers, topic entries, and reference knowledge for read-heavy chat usage.
- Important methods: LoadPromptAsync, LoadQuickAnswersAsync, LoadKnowledgeTextAsync, LoadTopicsAsync, InvalidateProfileCache.
- Backoffice updates should invalidate profile cache so saved prompt/knowledge changes are visible to chat.
- Chat history is not cached.
- Browser-side FAQ cache was removed to avoid stale user/profile behavior. If stale answers appear, check cache invalidation logs and whether the API was restarted after code/template changes.
